home_notice: Welcome to Whotel RWA. Tokenize, trade, and manage real-world assets across real estate, finance, Web3, venture capital, and entertainment. The platform brings access, liquidity, and transparency to asset tokenization: compliant, no-code, with integrated KYC/KYB and a clear path to onboarding. Complete KYC to get started.
home_tagline: A professional solution for asset tokenization
home_rwa_headline: Tokenize, trade, and manage any financial instrument
home_rwa_body: Redefining access, liquidity, and transparency in real-world asset tokenization.
home_solution_clients_body: KYC/AML workflows for smooth, compliant onboarding.
home_solution_contracts_body: Escrow accounts safeguard funds before investment.
home_solution_payments_body: Issue security tokens and keep records on-chain, with full transparency.
home_industry_body: See how businesses across industries use real-world assets to raise efficiency, broaden access, and open new opportunities.

project_utility_summary: The {symbol} token fuels the STR8FIRE ecosystem by granting governance rights, early access to tokenized content, and staking rewards. It’s the medium for transacting and participating across all STR8FIRE services and offerings.
project_utility_item_staking: Allows staking for passive yield and platform rewards.
project_utility_item_governance: Grants holders governance rights to shape ecosystem decisions.
project_utility_item_access: Unlocks early access to tokenized IP offerings (TIPOs).
project_utility_item_transactions: Used for ecosystem transactions including content access and IP investments.
project_business_summary: STR8FIRE tokenizes iconic entertainment IPs into investable digital assets, inviting fans and investors to co-own and fund media projects. Its ecosystem blends DeFi, AI, and creative industries to reimagine how IPs are financed and scaled.
project_business_item_tokenization: Converts entertainment IPs (games, films, comics) into tokenized investment vehicles.
project_business_item_ecosystem: Runs a Web3 ecosystem with tools like STR8PAD, STR8FUND, and STR8AI for IP development.
project_business_item_community: Empowers fans to co-invest and engage with the content they love.
project_business_item_collaboration: Collaborates with leading studios to transition Web2 IP into Web3 formats.
